# implement-spec ledger — P09.1 Coverage, completeness, and negative space
- Spec: docs/tickets/P09.1__coverage.md (canonical §9.5, §32)
- Base commit: a9826aa (devin/p08-3-contradiction-object); Branch: devin/p09-1-coverage
- Package: inference/src/inference/ (§47 "L4 derivations / §32 derived metrics"); db/absence.py extended; tests in tests/unit/ (+ tests/inference/)

## Context (Phase 0.3)
- inference/ is a blank skeleton (cli only). §47: inference = "L4 derivations"; §32 = "derived metrics that summarize" claims (line 276). Coverage-metrics layer lands here.
- db/src/db/absence.py ALREADY models the four §9.5 epistemic states (AbsenceState StrEnum: NOT_RESEARCHED/NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND/EVIDENCE_OF_ABSENCE/UNRESOLVED), the state<->coverage_kind map (not_researched/searched_not_found/evidence_of_absence), UNRESOLVED_CONTRADICTION_STATE, render_absence() (SIG-TIME-011/012). Missing: not_applicable rendering. REUSE + extend, don't duplicate.
- db/deploy/graph_annotations.sql coverage_record table exists: subject_id, subject_class, jurisdiction_id, predicate_id, absence_kind, sources_searched[], searched_at/by, search_method, CHECK(absence_kind<>'searched_not_found' OR sources_searched IS NOT NULL). Physical enforcement of SIG-METRIC-001/002 already present at DB layer.
- ontology CoverageRecord entity in entities.yaml (subject/predicate/absence_kind/coverage_period/denominator_published) + AbsenceKind enum in common.yaml (4 kinds). Generated pydantic/sql exist. LinkML is source of truth; `make gen` must stay byte-clean (verify-gen gate).
- Freshness: reconcile.weight.currency(volatility_class, half_life, observed_at, as_of) -> C1..C4 + half_life_days() + predicate_registry(); reconcile.ruleset exposes volatility_class/half_life per predicate. Currency enum C1-C4 in common.yaml. REUSE for SIG-METRIC-006 (relative-to-volatility freshness), NOT absolute days.
- Discovery-probe negatives (SIG-METRIC-002a): connectors/records.py coverage_record_row() shows the emit pattern (no_responsive_records -> searched_not_found). Candidate identifier spaces (portal slugs / agency ids / tenant names) — connectors emit candidate_identifier.
- exports/dossier.py has incompleteness_banner/gaps precedent for published "what we don't know".
- Governance the phase-gate (§51.3) needs updated: docs/traceability.md (append P09.1 section), docs/risk_register.md (append Phase 9 P09.1), docs/adr/ADR-038 for the deviation (pure-Python metrics aligned to DDL, no live PG; capture-recapture ban as executable refusal).

## Design decisions
- DD1: New inference package modules: coverage.py (CoverageRecord runtime entity + validation + probe-negative retention + §9.5 render), denominators.py (PublishedAggregate: denominator+not_evaluable mandatory, bare-count refusal; per-jurisdiction coverage; provenance completeness), freshness.py (volatility-relative freshness via reconcile.weight.currency; per-source freshness surface), completeness.py (capture-recapture/multi-list PROHIBITED refusal; records-derived recall exception guardrails; publish counted/bounds/recall never a total).
- DD2: inference depends on sig-db + sig-reconcile (workspace) — add to inference/pyproject.toml. Reuse db.absence + reconcile.weight.currency rather than reimplement.
- DD3: Pure-Python value objects aligned to graph_annotations.sql; NO live Postgres persistence (continues ADR-031/036/037 precedent). ADR-038 records it. HTTP API envelope is P14.1 (out of scope); we provide public_view()/render dicts.
- DD4: absence_kind not_applicable gets a distinguishable rendering added to db.absence.render_absence (4 coverage kinds fully renderable). AbsenceKind (4) vs AbsenceState (4) — note not_applicable has no epistemic AbsenceState; render at coverage-kind level.
- DD5: Capture-recapture prohibition (SIG-METRIC-008/008a) = an executable refusal: a function that REFUSES to produce a population total from two lists, raising; and a guard asserting no published aggregate is a population/total estimate. The one legitimate exception (SIG-METRIC-008b records-derived recall) is a constrained, labelled "field-survey recall" object, never extrapolated.

## Deliverables / ACs (from spec)
D1 CoverageRecord entity §32.1 full field set; sources_searched REQUIRED for searched_not_found (SIG-METRIC-001/002)
D2 discovery-probe negatives retained as searched_not_found (SIG-METRIC-002a)
D3 four absence kinds -> §9.5 states; API+UI render distinguishably; never collapse not_researched into searched_not_found (SIG-TIME-010/011/012)
D4 published denominators: every aggregate carries denominator+not_evaluable; per-jurisdiction coverage published (SIG-METRIC-003/004)
D5 provenance completeness measured+published, target 100%, shortfall=defect list (SIG-METRIC-005)
D6 freshness relative to predicate volatility + per-source freshness surface (SIG-METRIC-006/007)
D7 completeness guardrails: capture-recapture + multi-list prohibited; records-derived recall exception constrained; publish counted/bounds/ratios/recall never a total/implied denominator (SIG-METRIC-008/008a/008b/009/010)

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
AC1 CoverageRecord missing sources_searched for searched_not_found -> rejected (deterministic)
AC2 every published aggregate carries a denominator+not_evaluable; a bare count fails the build (deterministic)
AC3 four absence kinds distinguishable in API and UI; not_researched != searched_not_found render (deterministic API; agentic UI)
AC4 freshness computed relative to predicate volatility, not absolute days (deterministic)
AC5 completeness estimate publishes violated assumptions or is omitted; no capture-recapture/multi-list pop estimate ever published (deterministic)
AC6 phase-gate §51.3: CI green incl data-quality; automated tests; ADR for deviation; traceability updated; risk register updated

## Out of scope (confirm NOT done)
- research-task generation / resolved_no_evidence_exists disposition (P10.1/P10.3)
- public read API HTTP envelope + coverage statement wiring (P14.1)
- methodology/coverage web pages (P15.5)
- contradiction detection / UNRESOLVED resolution (P08.x — consumed here)

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)
tests/unit/test_absence.py (extend): not_applicable renders distinguishably (5 distinct codes incl NOT_APPLICABLE); render_coverage_kind for all 4 kinds; not_applicable has no epistemic state (state_from_coverage_kind raises); AbsenceRendering.state Optional.

  T-C1 searched_not_found without sources_searched -> ValueError (AC1)
  T-C2 CoverageRecord requires subject identity; full field set; other kinds allow empty sources
  T-C3 four absence kinds render distinguishably via public_view (AC3 API); not_researched != searched_not_found
  T-C4 epistemic_state maps 3 kinds; not_applicable -> None
  T-C5 probe_coverage_records retains negatives only (absent), keyed by candidate id, searched_not_found (AC 002a); present excluded; inconsistent present -> raise; empty sources -> raise
tests/inference/test_denominators.py (D4/D5):
  T-D1 PublishedAggregate carries denominator+not_evaluable; phrase() conformant; count>denominator -> raise (AC2)
  T-D2 assert_denominated rejects a bare int (AC2 "bare count fails the build")
  T-D3 jurisdiction_coverage: agencies_known + the 4 evidence aggregates denominated by n; mean age over dated only (None when none); weight-class distribution; open-contradiction sum; dup id -> raise (SIG-METRIC-004)
  T-D4 provenance_completeness: shortfall is a defect list (named ids); share; is_complete; 100% -> complete; defect count mismatch -> raise (SIG-METRIC-005)
tests/inference/test_freshness.py (D6):
  T-F1 same age different currency for FAST vs IMMUTABLE predicate -> relative to volatility not days (AC4)
  T-F2 IMMUTABLE never stale however old; FAST stale past window
  T-F3 source_freshness surface: stale_count via predicate class, tracked_count, status carried, as_json (SIG-METRIC-007)
tests/inference/test_completeness.py (D7):
  T-E1 capture_recapture_population raises ProhibitedEstimateError (AC5, SIG-METRIC-008)
  T-E2 multi_list_log_linear_population raises (SIG-METRIC-008a)
  T-E3 CompletenessStatement rejects reality/total denominator (SIG-METRIC-010); carries violated_assumptions; assert_no_population_total rejects bare number (SIG-METRIC-009)
  T-E4 RecordsDerivedRecall: requires pre_registered; window<half-life; recall=found/inventory; statement() is measured_survey_recall denominated by inventory, not extrapolated (SIG-METRIC-008b)
